answer: A proof-of-space gate protects the grove: each identity must reserve unique disk sectors holding a verifier-chosen salted dataset before its vote counts, and auditors probe random sectors every round. A hollow identity with no storage fails instantly and its 18,000 POA bond burns. A fable of clones sharing one dataset collapses because sector proofs cannot be copied between keys, so each fake identity pays a full storage lease plus 18,000 POA, scaling linearly, while an honest node verifies once.
